#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Requires Bash 4+, PostgreSQL client tools, AWS CLI v2, flock, and GNU date.
# Configure PostgreSQL via libpq (PGDATABASE, PGHOST, PGSERVICE, PGPASSFILE,
# etc.) and AWS via the normal AWS CLI credential/region provider chain.
# Required: S3_BUCKET, S3_PREFIX (a dedicated, nonempty prefix per database).
# Optional: RETENTION_DAYS (default 30), TMPDIR, LOCK_FILE (private directory).
# Retention is based on S3 LastModified, not the host-generated filename.
# On versioned buckets, configure lifecycle expiration for noncurrent versions.
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
export LC_ALL=C AWS_PAGER='' AWS_CLI_AUTO_PROMPT=off

log() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +'%FT%TZ')" "$*" >&2; }
die() { log "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
trap 'log "ERROR: command failed at line $LINENO (status $?)"' ERR

: "${S3_BUCKET:?Set S3_BUCKET}"
: "${S3_PREFIX:?Set S3_PREFIX to a dedicated backup prefix}"
retention=${RETENTION_DAYS:-30}
[[ $retention =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$ ]] || die 'RETENTION_DAYS must be 1..99999'
[[ $S3_BUCKET =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$ ]] || die 'Invalid bucket name'
prefix=${S3_PREFIX%/}
[[ $prefix =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+(/[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)*$ ]] || die 'Invalid prefix'
[[ /$prefix/ != */../* && /$prefix/ != */./* ]] || die 'Invalid prefix component'

for cmd in pg_dump pg_restore aws flock date mktemp stat sha256sum python3; do
    command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null || die "Missing dependency: $cmd"
done

if [[ -n ${LOCK_FILE:-} ]]; then
    exec 9>>"$LOCK_FILE"
else
    # A private persistent directory avoids lock-file replacement races.
    lockdir=${XDG_STATE_HOME:-${HOME:?}/.local/state}/pg-s3-backup
    mkdir -p -- "$lockdir"
    lockid=$(printf '%s/%s' "$S3_BUCKET" "$prefix" | sha256sum)
    exec 9>>"$lockdir/${lockid%% *}.lock"
fi
flock -n 9 || die 'Could not acquire backup lock'

work=$(mktemp -d -- "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pg-s3.XXXXXXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    local rc=$?
    trap - EXIT
    rm -rf -- "$work" || rc=1
    exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 129' HUP
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM

stamp=$(date -u +'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
nonce=$(python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4().hex)')
key="$prefix/pgbackup-$stamp-$nonce.dump"
uri="s3://$S3_BUCKET/$key"
archive="$work/backup.dump"

log 'Creating PostgreSQL custom-format archive'
pg_dump --no-password --format=custom --file="$archive"
pg_restore --list "$archive" >/dev/null
size=$(stat -c %s -- "$archive")
(( size > 0 )) || die 'Empty archive'

log "Uploading $uri"
aws s3 cp "$archive" "$uri" --only-show-errors --no-progress \
    --checksum-algorithm SHA256
remote_size=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$S3_BUCKET" --key "$key" \
    --query ContentLength --output text)
[[ $remote_size == "$size" ]] || die 'Uploaded object size mismatch; skipping rotation'

# AWS CLI automatically paginates. Finish listing and validating the entire
# deletion plan before deleting anything; never parse arbitrary keys in shell.
aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$S3_BUCKET" --prefix "$prefix/pgbackup-" \
    --query 'Contents[].{key:Key,modified:LastModified}' --output json >"$work/list"

python3 - "$work/list" "$prefix" "$key" "$retention" >"$work/expired" <<'PY'
import datetime as dt
import json
import re
import sys

path, prefix, current, days = sys.argv[1:]
pattern = re.compile(re.escape(prefix) + r"/pgbackup-[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{32}\.dump")
cutoff = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) - dt.timedelta(days=int(days))
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    objects = json.load(stream)
if not isinstance(objects, list) or not any(o["key"] == current for o in objects):
    sys.exit("Uploaded backup missing from listing; refusing rotation")
for obj in objects:
    key = obj["key"]
    if key != current and pattern.fullmatch(key):
        when = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(obj["modified"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        if when < cutoff:
            print(key)
PY

removed=0
while IFS= read -r expired; do
    aws s3api delete-object --bucket "$S3_BUCKET" --key "$expired" >/dev/null
    removed=$((removed + 1))
done <"$work/expired"
log "Backup complete: $uri ($size bytes); expired $removed backup(s)"
